gripOrHq.title: Sunburst Cranial Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Put [1] from the bank on Cranial Interface when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

gripOrHq.title: Disintegrator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Derez a piece of ice and end your run. Use this ability only when you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice and have successfully passed it.

gripOrHq.title: Big Frackin' Gun
gripOrHq.rulesText: [6]: Break up to five sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Redecorator
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break up to two sentry subroutines on a single piece of ice. [3]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Crumble
heapOrArchives.rulesText: After each successful run on HQ, give the Corp a Crumble counter. Two or more Crumble counters allow you trash, at no cost, any cards accessed from HQ, even if the cards cannot normally be trashed. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: The Short Circuit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

rig.title: Wrecking Ball
rig.rulesText: [0]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Wrecking Ball, lose [1] from a stealth card.

rig.title: Viral Pipeline
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Bulldozer
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. If Bulldozer breaks all the subroutines of a wall, and the next piece of ice encountered during this run is a sentry, break one of the subroutines of that sentry, at no cost. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Bulldozer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Headhunters
scoreArea.rulesText: Whenever Corporate Headhunters successfully does damage, Runner 's hand size is reduced by 1. A: Do 1 meat damage. Use this ability only if Runner is tagged.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Bel-Digmo Antibody
root.rulesText: Shuffle Bel-Digmo Antibody into R&D when it is rezzed. When Runner accesses Bel-Digmo Antibody from R&D, do 1 Net damage, and Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.
